  • how is the pvp,

  • how is farm etc. do i need to focus on this game only or can i play casually and still have fun?

PvP is a gear game. If you have more money, you will have better gear and have a significant advantage over other players. At the moment, the gear caps at +15. It will take a decent investment of time to get full +15 gear with 5 ap accessories but once you do you'll be within 90-95% of somebody that's been grinding at cap for weeks on a 16-hour-a-day schedule. Close enough that other considerations become significant.

The only recourse here is that at +15 cap, the reasonable upper limit of money -> power is not too far diverged from vanilla +15. Furthermore, there's no way to buy money in the game, so you can't just open your wallet to win either.

The PvE is repetitive, but PvE is always repetitive. There are world bosses, but no instanced content (game is a seamless open world).

I briefly covered what you get out of grinding. Another thing to keep in mind is that there are no shortcuts. If your buddy is a 16-hour-a-day no-lifer, he can't give you +15 gear on day one. You have to earn the silver to get it yourself.
